text:
Leah Gomez: did a short SR + keyboard sweep on the Dashboard Filters + Table. jotting high-level issues.
Ravi Shah: nice, lay it on us.
Leah Gomez: 1) Filter chips (.filter-chip) are buttons visually, but VoiceOver reads them as 'text' sometimes. needs role=button and aria-pressed (or role=checkbox) to announce selected state. current pattern toggles via JS only.
Nora Li: are they using button elements or divs?
Leah Gomez: divs with click handlers. easy win: switch to <button> or add tabindex=0 + aria-pressed. also add aria-label when chip text is icon-only (eg, "avg latency filter").
Ravi Shah: noted. next?
Leah Gomez: 2) Date range picker: keyboard focus doesn't land on calendar day cells; users can't pick a date without the mouse. react-datepicker variant we use renders <td> with role=presentation. make days focusable buttons with aria-selected and descriptive aria-label like "June 3, 2025, selected". also ensure input has aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded toggled.
Nora Li: there's also a custom quick-range menu that closes on blur when arrow keys used. need to trap focus while open.
Leah Gomez: yep, focus trap and Escape to close.
Ravi Shah: oof.
Leah Gomez: 3) Data table: column headers missing scope attributes; NVDA reads "column header" but not content. add <th scope=\"col\" id=\"col-...\"> and make sort buttons inside header with aria-sort set to "ascending"/"descending". also provide aria-describedby with sorting instructions for screen reader users.
Nora Li: table rows have action icons without aria-labels (download, drill). need aria-label or visually hidden text.
Leah Gomez: 4) Charts: tooltips are canvas-based and not keyboard-focusable. fallback: expose a hidden accessible data table or an offscreen SVG DOM that mirrors series and tooltips. legend items should be buttons (tabbable) that show the series value on focus via aria-describedby.
Ravi Shah: good pattern. any color issues?
Leah Gomez: 5) Contrast: the low-contrast token we use for helper text in light theme falls to ~3.1:1 on small text. propose swapping to token `--muted-contrast-2` #667085 or bump weight to medium for small sizes. I'll add exact token suggestions in the design PR.
Nora Li: also check focus ring color in high-contrast mode — current ring uses the same hue as the page bg in HC theme; make it high-visibility (#FFD166 or system focus color).
product-bot: design token request created: DT-3147 (muted-contrast-2).
a11y-bot: automated scan summary: axe found violations: 1) form-field-label-missing x2, 2) color-contrast x1, 3) focusable-content x1. report: https://scans.redwood/1778500123-axe.json
Leah Gomez: proposed priority: P0 = keyboard access for datepicker + filter ARIA + table header semantics; P1 = chart keyboard fallbacks + contrast tokens; P2 = motion prefs and microcopy tweaks.
Ravi Shah: I'll pick up P0 (date picker & filters) and add unit tests. estimate 2.5 dev days.
Nora Li: i'll handle chart fallbacks and focus-ring tokens. will update the token table and add the SVG fallback prototype.
Leah Gomez: acceptance criteria I'll add to the ticket: 1) tab order on dashboard covers filter chips -> datepicker input -> calendar days -> chart legend -> table rows -> actions. 2) SR announces filter state and table column headers properly. 3) toasts use role=status + aria-live=polite for job completion announcements.
Ravi Shah: can we add a tiny e2e that tabs through the filter toolbar and asserts expected labels? puppeteer sends keyboard events and checks aria-pressed values.
Leah Gomez: yes please. add some flakiness tolerance for animations. also respect prefers-reduced-motion when running in CI to avoid timeouts.
Ravi Shah: filed INF-6199 (a11y: dashboard filters, datepicker, table semantics). assigned to @Ravi Shah and @Nora Li.
Nora Li: starting branch fix/a11y-dashboard-6199 now. will link design tokens + screenshot examples in the PR.
Leah Gomez: i'll attach short VoiceOver + NVDA clips and step-by-step notes in the JIRA (links included).
product-bot: JIRA INF-6199 created and linked to DT-3147.
Ravi Shah: once PR is ready run axe + a11y-bot and we'll merge behind feature flag.
Leah Gomez: thx all — small fixes but big UX impact. :white_check_mark:
